C01.why: Reference. Beam best ctrl 0.171 (38/48 feasible), but coarse FEA puts the PA6-CF root fitting at 4.2, so it needs capability #1 (rod continuity into rigid parts).

C02.why: Best ctrl 0.013. A laminate that is thin enough to bend in lag is too weak in creep, and one thick enough is too stiff (lag mode 0.9/rev with no pitch). Re-test only with GF/aramid (backlog #5).

C03.why: Torsion bar: ctrl 0.076 and the ONLY root family whose best point also passes coarse FEA (max 0.66, root fitting). Best confirmed-printable candidate.

C04.why: Best ctrl 0.001. A straight radial rod clamped at the hub and the blade is a lag cantilever. The free-floating through-hub version is not modelled (N02).

C05.why: Integral graded prop with the rod continuing into the blade: ctrl 0.212 (34/48 feasible). FEA 3.3 at the root fitting and blade, because the solid model still lacks a rod embedded into the blade (backlog #1). Fred's 'whole prop as one part'.

C06.why: Printed PA6-CF/PETG-CF 'rods' inside TPU: 0/48 feasible, creep 2.6x at best.

C07.why: Fully printed torsion bar: 0/48 feasible, creep of the printed bar or strap 1.9x.

C08.why: Symmetric PA6-CF crossed plates: ctrl 0.032, only 3/48 feasible. It is the only feasible fully-FDM concept, but FEA flags the plate at 3.2, so it is marginal.

C09.why: Crossed TPU+rod plates: ctrl 0.041, below C01 with more parts. FEA did not converge (stress stiffening).

C10.why: FACT 5-wire set in CF: ctrl 0.067, 14/48 feasible, distinct topology. FEA mesh failed (backlog #11).

C11.why: Trapezoid / remote-centre pivot: ctrl 0.019, lag mode above 1/rev in most samples.

C12.why: TPU plate + radial strap: ctrl 0.004. The strap stiffens lag far too much (agrees with the earlier study).

C13.why: Flex-beam + inclined pitch link: ctrl 0.010, 1/48 feasible. The link geometry produces little pitch-lag coupling in the ranges tried.

C14.why: Thick TPU shear pad + strap: ctrl 0.003.

C15.why: Chordwise offset instead of skew: the best point needed 16.6 deg skew for ctrl 0.041. The offset alone does not couple. Needs sweep (N06) to test properly.

C16.why: Raster-steered PA6-CF: ctrl 0.015, creep-limited. The beam model has no bend-twist coupling (backlog #6).

C17.why: Spring-steel shim: ctrl 0.036 in the beam model, but FEA root fitting 2.1 and steel 1.2.

C18.why: Insect-vein X wires in a TPU pad: ctrl 0.130, 17/48 feasible, a diverse alternative to parallel rods. FEA mesh failed (backlog #11).

C19.why: Steel LE wire in the outer blade (lag inertia): ctrl 0.220, the best root-family value. FEA 2.2 (root fitting), the same failure as C01.

B01.why: Wide-chord blade, 5.0 in, c/R 0.32, taper 0.82: ctrl 0.296, the best overall. FoM 0.74, lag 0.75/rev. FEA 2.7 (rod-root fitting).

B02.why: Inverse taper (tip-heavy) 6.75 in at 10.6k rpm: ctrl 0.179 with lag 0.58/rev, the most resonance-robust point. FoM 0.69. FEA invalid (disconnected solid, 57 mm displacement) and must be rerun.

B03.why: Twist law: ctrl 0.206 with a low-alpha (4.9 deg), high-lambda twist. Small lever compared with chord or diameter.

B04.why: Camber/thickness: NACA 4414-ish at 5.6 in, ctrl 0.269, and 0.247 at lag 0.62/rev, so robust. FEA 2.7 (rod-root fitting).

B05.why: Root cut-out 0.29 / hinge 8.7 mm at 5.9 in: ctrl 0.237, and 0.222 at lag 0.60/rev. FEA 2.1.

B06.why: Joint blade+root LHS: ctrl 0.247. FEA crashed (gmsh segfault) and must be rerun.

B07.why: Torsion-bar root + blade shape: ctrl 0.059 at lag 0.56/rev. Combines with C03's FEA-clean root, so it is the natural converge-phase seed.
